name: RACI Alignment Mapping
deliverable: Structural assignment of Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, and Informed

steps.text: List the decisions or deliverables that each need one clear owner before work starts.
For each row, name who is responsible for the work and exactly one person accountable for it.
Check overload, then confirm each person accepts.

failure: Two accountable names in a row, or a name in every column, so the map looks full while decisions stall.
intervention: Put one accountable name in every row, and remove anyone marked both who does not do the work.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A responsibility charting convention used across project management; no single documented originator.
